title.narrative: Strengthening regional work on disaster-risk reduction through education in Asia and the Pacific

description.narrative: The Asia-Pacific region faces frequent disruptions to schooling due to floods, storms, and increasing climate-related risks. These challenges pressure education systems to maintain learning continuity, yet many countries lack practical, context-specific tools for teachers and officials, particularly impacting vulnerable groups such as girls, children in remote areas, and those with disabilities. UNESCO is well positioned to support through its regional coordination and expertise in resilient education systems. This work will develop practical DRR training materials based on an all-hazards, all-risks approach, while documenting good practices to support regional learning, policy dialogue, and stronger, more inclusive and resilient education systems.
